# 🚨 PVC Disk Capacity Alert

> **Davis® forecasts that a PersistentVolumeClaim will run out of space within the next few hours.**

---

## 📊 What Davis detected

| | |
|---|---|
| 🔮 **Signal** | `dt.kubernetes.persistentvolumeclaim.used` |
| 📈 **Model** | Davis® Generic Forecast — 90% coverage, 200 paths |
| ⏳ **Horizon** | next several hours |
| 🚧 **Threshold** | **2 GiB** projected usage |
| 🧭 **Scope** | per `k8s.cluster.name` / `k8s.persistent_volume_claim.name` |

---

## ⚠️ Why it matters

When a PVC fills up, the workload writing to it can no longer persist data — pods may **crash-loop**, **fail readiness checks**, or **silently lose writes**. Acting *before* the volume is full turns a midnight outage into a routine change.

## 🛠️ Recommended actions

1. **🔍 Inspect** — identify the PVC and the pod(s) writing to it.
2. **🧹 Reclaim space** — rotate or compact logs, clear temp data, prune old artifacts.
3. **📦 Expand the PVC** — raise the storage request if the growth is legitimate.
4. **📉 Re-check the forecast** — confirm the predicted curve flattens after remediation.

---

🔗 **Open the workflow execution** to view the predicted curve and the exact volume at risk.

_Sent automatically by the **Predictive PVC Usage** workflow · powered by Dynatrace Davis® AI_ ✨
